java.say: Ride keeps the tariff as a word, such as "minute" or "day".
A switch picks the rule for the word. "minute": 0.25 per minute.
"day": 15.00 for every started day of 1440 minutes.

java.at: // A student subscription? Change this method again.
java.say: Every new tariff adds another rule to this method. Ride must change each time, so it breaks Open/Closed.
A word with a typo is only found when the program runs.
